title: File:Big Bear Valley, California.jpg
claims: The image looks east from the Butler Peak lookout tower across Big Bear Valley: forested ridges, a blue lake and the town around the shore, with a trail visible in the foreground.

The Commons description places the view in San Bernardino National Forest and names Big Bear Valley; it is a valley overview, not a race-day photograph, and has no course markers, timing mats or aid tables.
The author is jcookfisher; the file is CC BY 2.0; the photograph was taken on 2006-07-02 at 11:50; the original is 2,592 x 1,728 pixels and 3,422,075 bytes; the credit line reads Big Bear Valley.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 224,336 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source.
